# Fineguide.ai

> Fineguide is a next-generation, AI-native platform for business operations that unifies customer conversations, CRM, voice, workspace, and automations onto one spine. Instead of duct-taping together seven separate tools, teams run AI assistants, a shared customer record, voice quality assurance, document workspace, and workflow automations from a single platform. Every conversation across every channel connects to one customer record, so sales, support, customer success, and call-center operations all see the same context.

The platform is organized into modules that share one customer record:

- **Assistants**: Configurable AI that answers customers on web, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, Slack, and Discord. Each assistant reads your knowledge (URLs, documents, PDFs), follows your rules, uses a configurable persona/voice/escalation policy, extracts intent and customer data directly into CRM leads, and supports live monitoring, analytics, and human handoff.
- **CRM**: One customer record across every team: conversations, contacts, leads, pipelines and stages (Kanban and table views), tasks and assignments, tickets and support cases, a team inbox, and a routing queue. Custom fields are auto-filled by assistants. Identity survives the channel switch.
- **Voice**: Voice QA automatically transcribes and scores every call against per-department criteria and weights, in 30+ languages, with agent feedback and trend dashboards. Voice AI (rolling out) puts the same assistants on live inbound and outbound phone calls, connected to your own phone system over SIP.
- **Workspace**: A block-based editor (slash commands, folder hierarchy, drag-drop, full-text search, soft-delete recovery) for playbooks, briefs, and team knowledge, connected to the same contacts and customers.
- **Automations**: An embedded n8n instance (hosted on Fineguide infrastructure or bring-your-own) with webhooks on conversations, leads, and tickets, plus hundreds of pre-built integrations.
- **QA & Analytics**: Score every interaction, track performance across teams, and surface insights that drive improvement.

## What makes Fineguide different

- **One platform, not a stack.** Conversations, CRM, voice, workspace, and automations share a single customer record, replacing the seven tools teams would otherwise integrate by hand. No export/import dance between systems.
- **AI-native from the ground up**, not a chatbot bolted onto legacy software. The same configurable assistants run across chat channels and (rolling out) live phone calls.
- **Channel-agnostic identity.** A customer's record and conversation history persist across web, messaging apps, and voice, so sales, support, customer success, and call-center teams all see the same context.
- **Automation depth via embedded n8n** (hosted or bring-your-own), with webhooks on conversations, leads, and tickets and hundreds of pre-built integrations.
- **Enterprise-ready:** on-premise deployment on your own infrastructure, platform adaptation, SLAs, GDPR compliance, and consultancy.
- **All AI modules included in every plan**: pricing scales on usage (credits) and seats, not on locking features behind tiers.

## Who it's for

- **Sales teams**: qualify leads faster with AI assistants that capture intent and write structured records into CRM.
- **Support centers**: handle volume without growing headcount.
- **Call-center operations**: evaluate call quality automatically and coach agents in real time with Voice QA.
- **Customer success teams**: keep accounts coherent across every channel on one shared record.

## Pricing

Credit-based, with all AI modules included from the start. One subscription per organization. No setup fees, cancel anytime, free trial.

- **Free**: €0/month forever. 200 credits to explore the platform, no card required. 1 member (hard cap), 1M characters of knowledge base, community support, pay-as-you-go top-ups (€45 / 1,000 extra credits).
- **Starter**: €100/month. 3,000 credits (≈ 3,000 text conversations or 250 minutes Voice QA). 3 seats included, €20 per extra seat, 5M characters of knowledge base, email support, all AI modules. Extra credits €40 / 1,000.
- **Business**: €200/month (most popular). 8,000 credits (≈ 8,000 text conversations or 660 minutes Voice QA). 5 seats included, €18 per extra seat, 10M characters of knowledge base, priority support, advanced analytics. Extra credits €30 / 1,000.
- **Premium**: €500/month. 25,000 credits (≈ 25,000 text conversations or 2,000 minutes Voice QA). 10 seats included, €15 per extra seat, 20M characters of knowledge base, dedicated support, API & webhooks access. Extra credits €24 / 1,000.
- **Enterprise**: custom plans with custom credit packages, volume discounts, priority support & SLA, a dedicated account manager, on-premise deployment, and platform adaptation.

Paid plans do not cap team size: the included seats are what the price covers, and further seats are billed per seat at the rate above. Free is owner-only.

**Add-ons**: each part of the plan scales on its own, billed monthly alongside the subscription and removable at any time:

- **Extra seats**: €20/seat on Starter, €18 on Business, €15 on Premium. No cap on team size for paid plans.
- **Extra credits**: €40 / 1,000 on Starter, €30 on Business, €24 on Premium, €45 on Free. Purchased credits stack on the monthly allowance and never expire.
- **Context Packs**: €20/month per pack, adding 5,000,000 characters (~1,000 documents) of knowledge-base capacity. Unlimited packs per account.

**How credits are consumed:** text message = 1 credit; message + attachment = 2 credits; Voice QA = 12 credits/minute; Voice AI = 10 credits/minute (30 credits/minute on premium voices). Everything else is included free and consumes no credits: CRM, Inbox, Messages, workflows, analytics, reports, team collaboration and integrations.

## Pricing FAQ

- **Do credits expire?** Monthly subscription credits reset each billing cycle. Extra credit packs never expire.
- **Can I change plans?** Yes, upgrade or downgrade anytime; changes take effect the next billing cycle. Extra credits can be purchased anytime.
- **What happens if I run out of credits?** You can buy extra credits instantly; assistants keep working, and you're notified before credits run out.
- **Is there a free trial?** Yes. All new accounts receive free credits to test the platform before choosing a paid plan.

## Integrations & languages

Integrates with: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, Slack, Discord, AmoCRM, Kommo, Zendesk, HelpScout, and n8n (plus hundreds more via n8n workflows). The platform supports 30+ languages across voice transcription and customer conversations, and the site is localized in English (`/`) and Romanian (`/ro/`).
